name: List contact activities
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the recent activities (tasks, notes, campaigns, ecommerce events) for a specific contact. Use the neighbouring action "contacts.get_contact" if you only need basic contact details instead of the activity feed.
preconditions: The contact identified by contact_id or email must exist.

contact_id.description: Unique identifier of the contact whose activities are being fetched.

email.description: Email address of the contact (alternative to contact_id).

limit.description: Maximum number of activity items to return.

planned.description: If true, include only planned activities.

pinned.description: If true, include only pinned activities.

items.description: An activity object (task, note, campaign, etc.).
List of activity entries matching the query.

date_offset.description: Offset date used for pagination, if applicable.

ecommerce_offset.description: Numeric offset for ecommerce activity pagination.

ecommerce_frame_date.description: Reference date for ecommerce activity framing.
